items.title: Pick your start screen
items.summary: Choose where CoffeeFlix opens. This is included in the 2.4.3 supporter preview and has been tried on Wii U.

items.title: GamePad controls when you need them
items.summary: Browse on both screens, then control playback from the GamePad. The 2.4.3 preview has passed its Wii U check.

items.title: CoffeeFlix on Android phones
items.summary: I’m making CoffeeFlix fit a phone, with bigger buttons and touch controls. Next up: checking the player and menus on real devices.

items.title: Small updates, tested first
items.summary: I’m keeping updates small so there’s time to try things out and catch problems before they reach everyone.

items.title: Supporter previews
items.summary: The 2.4.3 Wii U preview is available on Ko-fi. One-time donors get this preview and its fixes; monthly supporters get each new preview.

items.title: Android TV and Fire TV
items.summary: I’ll test playback, updates and remote controls on TV devices before sharing a download.
